item.title: Saudi Arabia Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in Saudi Arabia on Tuesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Extends recovery to near 155.30 as US Dollar gains
item.description: The USD/JPY pair is up 0.4% to near 155.30 during the late Asian trading session on Tuesday. The pair trades higher as the US Dollar (USD) extends its recovery move despite United States (US) President Donald Trump threatening higher tariffs on countries in case they dishonour trade agreements.

item.title: USD/INR edges down on likely FIIs return to Indian markets
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) ticks up against the US Dollar (USD) in the opening trade on Tuesday. The USD/INR pair edges down to near 91.10 on the expectation that the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has intervened in spot and forward markets to support the Indian Rupee.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Climbs above 109.50 as technicals support bullish outlook
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross attracts some buyers to near 109.60 during the early European session on Tuesday. Traders remain concerned over Japan's fiscal health amid expectations that Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi will announce more stimulus to boost the economy.

item.title: Australian Dollar outperforms its peers ahead of key inflation data
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) outperforms its major currency peers, trades 0.1% higher to near 0.7065 against the US Dollar (USD) during the early European trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: Gold bears seem hesitant as geopolitical risks and Fed rate cut bets counter USD uptick
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to modest intraday losses below the monthly peak touched earlier this Tuesday, though it lacks follow-through selling and holds above the $5,150 level heading into the European session.

item.title: EUR/GBP softens below 0.8750 on trade uncertainty
item.description: The EUR/GBP cross loses ground to near 0.8730 during the early European session on Tuesday. Renewed global trade concerns, including potential US tariff measures, weigh on the Euro (EUR) against the Pound Sterling (GBP).

item.title: Pound Sterling Price News & Forecast: GBP/USD falls as the US Dollar rebounds after two consecutive sessions of losses
item.description: GBP/USD edges lower after two days of gains, trading around 1.3480 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair declines as the US Dollar (USD) rebounds from losses recorded over the previous two sessions.

item.title: USD: Tariff uncertainty keeps Dollar on edge – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Michael Pfister notes that the initial weakness of the US Dollar after the Supreme Court tariff ruling has reversed, leaving USD pairs near pre-ruling levels. He stresses that the reaction is not clear-cut, with fiscal concerns offset by swift new tariffs.
